name: attendance-ai-root
description: Enterprise AI-Powered Multi-Tenant HR, Attendance, Task & Payroll Platform

scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npx prisma generate && cd ../frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
